dcterms:description: The Hands 2017 challenge dataset is composed of parts of the Big Hand 2.2M dataset and the First-person Hand Action Dataset (FHAD). It contains 957032 depth images of five different hands for training and 295510 depth images of ten different hand shapes for testing.
dcterms:title: Hands 2017 Challenge Dataset

dcterms:creator: D. H. Lee
dcterms:description: The NYU dataset contains 72757 training images of a single subject's hand and 8252 test images that include a second hand shape besides the one from the training set.
dcterms:title: NYU Dataset
